llm_proposer.assessment: The outage is a network-wide optical failure concentrated at the common ROADM dependency S01, not an isolated svc300 client-port or transponder fault. The simultaneous loss of input on two different outgoing S01 lines and widespread OCH/client failures most strongly indicate a failed WSS input port at S01.

proposals.rationale: Every affected working path depends on roadm.S01, and a failed WSS input port there can simultaneously block channels subsequently routed toward both S04 and S15, matching O1/O2 and the widespread service impact. A reservation is that no explicit WSS equipment alarm is shown.

A disconnected common incoming optical patch at S01 could remove all channels feeding a WSS degree and produce a similar multi-output loss. It is less likely because no recent S01 maintenance is reported and the precise common OMS input is not identified.
proposals.note: the element's equipment does not document the mode

proposals.rationale: A switch-fabric failure could interrupt many ODU services sharing S01. It is strongly disfavoured because an OTN-layer failure should not cause AMP_INPUT_LOS on two optical lines or widespread OCH_LOS.
